findings.evidence: Runner._run unconditionally obtains all four mutable preflights and reserve readiness even after signed retained-attempt lookup; consumed or expired inputs can therefore prevent exact completed-phase lookup. Current-set authentication is required separately; no upstream recovery bypass exists.

Receiver skips security-observation-append for every existing outer admission, including interruption before inner AppendAsync. Real recorder AppendAsync already proves DefinitiveAbsent/RetainedUnsent and uses a durable dispatch barrier; ordinary drain cannot reach that permitted path.

Compromise Step retry checks only consumption.LookupRevocationAsync!=null. Actual subscriber.ReceiveAsync additionally authenticates and confirms the same exact guard mirror; failure between block and mirror therefore becomes false success on recovery.

Compromise false is always treated as unknown, including cataloged authenticated substitution-rejection cases. ReceiveAsync bool conflates definitive rejection and unsettled outcomes. Those recipes cannot produce their expected measured denial or name the missing rejected-original protocol before admission.

Missing Register/Reserve/Block/Activate operation-original APIs are already explicit external contracts, and full driver flags remain false. Supported ordinary first operations can complete and retain their exact results; loss remains named Unknown without resend, as the intent requires. Unconditionally blocking every ordinary first operation because a future loss might require an absent API would discard independently supported implementation.

Normal JointPhaseCommandExecutable composition bypasses even the existing CohortAttempt validation and JointPhaseCommand only validates local phase/binding/cases. No receiving current retained-phase authorization protects supplied attempt/request/predecessor before native workflow dispatch.

Measured projector accepts signed surface scans without nonnegative count/unique exact-surface validation; an additional negative matchCount can cancel actual leakage to zero. Signed source authenticity does not validate its census semantics.

Measured projector forbiddenEffects/foreignEffects filters targetMutations through OfType<JsonObject>, silently dropping malformed nonobject writes. Neither native supplement correlation nor signed observation checks validates this per-entry schema upstream.

Guard invariant capabilityCompromiseBlockProof accepts any affected old-key revocation different from the current key. Current/retained guard receipts can contain an unrelated historical revocation, so this does not prove the exact predecessor capability/attestation replacement block.

Real GuardOriginalReader calls exact signer.LookupAsync(payload) and rejects payload/state mismatch. The shipped signing actor CaptureOutcome validates NoIssueProof payload/signing-request/detached-JWS digest and original-time bounds; ReadAsync reconciles the entire retained outcome through independent authority.ValidateStateAsync. ObsoleteUnissued only persists proof after two exact authenticated noIssueAuthority reads. Counting those independently verified original proofs does not accept arbitrary non-null input from the installed source.

carried: existing concurrent B7-4/E7-3 row has the same unchanged SaveAsync claim. Ledger atomic replacement may need32MiB before releasing a pending reserve while physical admission preserves only64KiB overhead. Keep that existing bad_spec route and do not create a second fix.

Native capacity checks AvailableFreeSpace before ImmutableFileArchive obtains publication ownership and deletes an interrupted path.pending. After reserve transfer and a killed writer, that temporary can consume the reserved space and exact retries permanently fail before reclaiming it. This is distinct from ledger rewrite headroom.

Pre-verified coverage gap: only concrete provider-credential workflow test returns the same independently valid inventory snapshot before/after GetSecret. It cannot detect removal of the equality guard; add valid revision change during response and assert null plus cleanup.
